# Bervic Invitations (www.bervic.in)

> Bervic is a premier Indian digital invitation generator for weddings, birthdays, religious functions (Puja, Griha Pravesh), and special celebrations. It enables users to create high-resolution, interactive digital invitations, RSVP tracking systems, and custom Instagram announcement cards in minutes.

## Core Capabilities & Features

- **Interactive Digital Invitations:** Dynamic web invitations featuring love stories, day-by-day event itineraries, venue map locations, photo galleries, background music, and RSVP management.
- **Instant WhatsApp Sharing:** Share personalized invitation links directly on WhatsApp, email, or social media without heavy PDF downloads.
- **31+ Premium Template Themes:** Handcrafted Indian wedding and event designs (Royal Gold, Botanical Luxe, Traditional Maroon, Boho Chic, Cinematic Modern).
- **Instagram Card Studio (`/cards`):** High-resolution (1080x1080px) Instagram & WhatsApp Status announcement card generator with 31+ design presets and custom photo uploader.
- **Real-Time Live Customizer:** Interactive builder with live visual preview, customizable typography, color palettes, and event section toggles.
- **Automated RSVP & Guest List:** Unique guest codes, attendance tracking, dietary preferences counter, and check-in metrics.

## URL Map & Navigation

- Main Homepage: https://www.bervic.in
- Template Catalog: https://www.bervic.in/templates
- Instagram Card Studio: https://www.bervic.in/cards
- User Login: https://www.bervic.in/auth/login
- Account Signup: https://www.bervic.in/auth/signup

## Pricing & Plans

- **Free Tier:** Access to basic templates, instant preview, and guest links.
- **Standard Pass (₹299 for 6 Months):** 1 Live Invitation, 5 Instagram Cards, Full Customization, RSVP tracking.
- **Cinematic Pass (₹999 for 1 Year):** 3 Live Invitations, 20 Instagram Cards, Audio Music Player, Video Embeds, Priority WhatsApp Delivery.
